scripts.reinstall: rm -rf node_modules renderer/node_modules && npm install && npm install --prefix renderer
scripts.renderer:build: npm run typecheck && npm run renderer:build:browser && npm run renderer:build:addon
scripts.renderer:deploy:addon: npm run renderer:build:addon && npx tsx renderer/html2slides/addon/deploy.ts
scripts.renderer:regen: npm run renderer:regen:basics && npm run renderer:regen:complex
scripts.renderer:rate:basics: lsof -ti:3456 | xargs -r kill; npx tsx renderer/html2slides/rating-server.ts /tmp/sxs --port 3456
scripts.renderer:rate:complex: lsof -ti:3457 | xargs -r kill; npx tsx renderer/html2slides/rating-server.ts /tmp/sxs-complex --port 3457
scripts.renderer:rate: lsof -ti:3456,3457 | xargs -r kill; npm run renderer:rate:basics & npm run renderer:rate:complex
